name: Septic Arthritis
definition: Acute infection of a synovial joint that can rapidly destroy cartilage and cause sepsis; it is a medical/orthopedic emergency.

redFlags.item: Immunosuppressed patient with hot swollen joint

investigations.principle: Urgent joint aspiration is central when feasible before antibiotics in stable patients.
investigations.MRI: MRI/ultrasound may help detect deep-joint effusion or osteomyelitis.

amber: Ayurvedic or conservative therapy must never delay emergency infection management.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhi-shotha phenotype may be recorded only after emergency modern diagnosis/treatment is secured.

patientEducation.summary: Acute infection of a synovial joint that can rapidly destroy cartilage and cause sepsis; it is a medical/orthopedic emergency.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
